jobs.title: Director, Technology Transformation
jobs.description:
Job Description

Your Role

The Technology team is responsible for the delivery, operation, and governance of secure, compliant, and scalable platforms that support critical healthcare services and enable the successful separation and long-term independence of the Ascendiun family of companies. The Director, Technology Transformation will report to the Chief Information Officer (CIO). In this role you will for lead cross-functional teams to deliver large-scale programs that create sustainable, systematic improvements across technology and business operations.

Our leadership model is about developing great leaders at all levels and creating opportunities for our people to grow – personally, professionally, and financially. We are looking for leaders that are energized by creative and critical thinking, building and sustaining high-performing teams, getting results the right way, and fostering continuous learning.

Responsibilities

Your Work

In this role, you will:

Lead strategic technology initiatives that improve operational performance, scalability, reliability, and customer experience.
Identify systemic challenges and drive sustainable solutions that address root causes rather than symptoms.
Develop and execute transformation roadmaps aligned with business objectives and technology strategy.
Partner with business and technology leaders to drive organizational change and process improvements.
Lead complex, cross-functional technology programs with multiple stakeholders, dependencies, and delivery teams.
Establish governance, milestones, success metrics, and reporting mechanisms to ensure program success.
Drive prioritization, issue resolution, risk management, and decision-making across initiatives.
Ensure projects are delivered on schedule, within budget, and aligned with business outcomes.
Lead efforts to improve system stability, service performance, operational maturity, and supportability.
Facilitate root-cause analysis and corrective action planning for recurring issues.
Build strong partnerships with business leaders, product owners, and technology teams.
Communicate program status, risks, dependencies, and recommendations to senior leadership.

Qualifications

Your Knowledge and Experience

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field.
Requires a minimum of 10 years of technology experience, including 6+ years in leadership roles managing enterprise technology initiatives.
Proven experience leading large-scale technology programs and transformational initiatives.
Strong understanding of enterprise applications, infrastructure, cloud technologies, and operational processes.
Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and drive organizational change.
Experience managing complex stakeholder environments and balancing competing priorities.

Hybrid

This role requires employees to be in-office based on our hybrid workplace model, balancing purposeful in-person collaboration with flexibility. For most teams, this means coming into the office two days each week.

Employees living more than 50 miles from an office location will work with their manager to determine in-office time based on business need.

About Us

About Stellarus and the Ascendiun Family of Companies

Stellarus, launched in January 2025, is designed to scale innovative healthcare solutions that support customers in creating a health care experience deserving of their family, friends, and neighbors.

Stellarus is part of a family of organizations that is overseen by a nonprofit corporate entity named Ascendiun. The Ascendiun Family of Companies also includes Blue Shield of California and its subsidiary, Blue Shield of California Promise Health Plan and Altais, a clinical services company.

Stellarus’ vision is to empower its customers to create a healthcare experience that is worthy of their family, friends, and neighbors. Stellarus’ objective is to offer innovative, modern, scalable solutions that challenge the health care status quo. This very closely aligns with Blue Shield of California’s vision by using innovation to improve quality, affordability, and experience for members.

To achieve our mission, we foster an environment where all employees can thrive and contribute fully to address the needs of the various communities we serve. We are committed to creating and maintaining a supportive workplace that upholds our values and advances our goals.

Our Values:

At Stellarus, our core values of agility, trust, drive, courage and service shape our approach to developing innovative product offerings.

Our Workplace Model:

We believe in fostering a workplace environment that balances purposeful in-person collaboration with flexibility - providing clear expectations while respecting the diverse needs of our workforce. Our workplace model is designed around intentional in-person interaction, collaboration, connection, creativity and flexibility:

For most teams, this means coming into the office two days per week.
Employees living more than 50 miles from an office location, out of state employees, and employees in certain member-facing roles should work with their manager to determine in-office time based on business need.
For employees with medical conditions that may impact their ability to work in-office, we are committed to engaging in an interactive process and providing reasonable accommodations to ensure their work environment is conducive to their success and well-being.

The Company reserves the right to require more presence in the office based on business needs, and requirements are subject to change with periodic reviews.

Physical Requirements:

Office Environment - roles involving part to full time schedule in Office Environment. Based in our physical offices and work from home office/deskwork - Activity level: Sedentary, frequency most of work day.

Please click here for further physical requirement detail.

Equal Employment Opportunity:

External hires must pass a background check/drug screen. Qualified applicants with arrest records and/or conviction records will be considered for employment in a manner consistent with Federal, State and local laws, including but not limited to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regards to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, protected veteran status or disability status and any other classification protected by Federal, State and local laws.

jobs.title: Program Manager (Cyber/IT Integration)
jobs.description:
Come be a part of something big! Smart Minds, Cool Jobs and Awesome Rewards! Fueled by innovation, talent and ambition, the Air Force Civilian Service (AFCS) is seeking civilian professionals prepared to deploy war-winning capabilities on behalf of the United States Air Force.

The Air Force Civilian Service (AFCS) is looking for a full-time Program Manager (Cyber/IT Integration), GG-0343-13 located Policy and Guidance Division (HQ USAF/A6XP), Joint Base Anacostia-Bolling, Arlington, VA.

Salary Rate:
$121,000 – 138,000

Relocation expenses may be paid based on eligibility.

This position is a Defense Civilian Intelligence Personnel System (DCIPS) position aligned under authorities of Section 1601, Chapter 83 of Title 10, United States Code and DoD Instruction 1400.25-V2007.

Depending on the type of position you are selected for, you will be required to serve a 1-year probationary period OR 2-year trial period.

This position can close at any time. Apply Now!

Shape the alignment of Air Force Warfighter Communications and Cyber Systems! We seek a Cyber/IT Integration Program Manager to serve as a key strategy, policy, and guidance coordinator on the Air Staff. In this role, you will synchronize high-level strategic plans across the Department of War (DoW) while providing the critical policy and guidance inputs that drives mission execution. Your focus will be on shaping governance frameworks, coordinating diverse strategy efforts, and ensuring our policies robustly support the joint warfighter. Secure your role in crafting the policies that defend our nation.

Must be a U.S. Citizen
Must be able to obtain/maintain a Top Secret/SCI clearance
This position is designated by the Air Force as a testing designated position under the Air Force Civilian Drug Testing Program and is subject to random drug testing
Knowledge of a wide range of qualitative and/or quantitative methods for the assessment and improvement of Air Force Warfighter Communications and Cyber Systems strategy and other programs in support of developing Planning, Programming, Budgeting, and Execution (PPBE), and policy, procedures, and schedules for developing PPBE inputs, including Program Objectives Memoranda (POM), Budget Estimate Submissions (BES), and Financial Planning and executions in support of major war, mobilization, and other contingency and operational plans as well as methods for developing budget forecasts, cost projections, financial exhibits, unfunded requirements justifications, POM narratives, offsets and disconnects, reclamas, issue papers, and budget documents.
Knowledge of military service program goals and objectives, the sequence and timing of key operational events and milestones, and methods of evaluating the effectiveness of planning actions as related to actual events.
Knowledge of the relationship of the various military entities involved in overall planning and execution of military operations and evaluations and the methods in which the PPBE process supports them.
Knowledge of a wide range of qualitative and/or quantitative methods for the assessment and improvement of command level plans and programs for conducting major operations such as Space Situational Awareness & Command and Control; Space Protection; Space Intelligence, Surveillance & Reconnaissance; Missile Warning/Defense; MILSATCOM; Space Position, Navigation & Timing; Space Testing, Training, Tactics & Exercises; Space Launch, Ranges & AF Satellite Control Network Operations; Cyber Integration; Global Information Grid Operations & Defense; Cyber Counter-Threat; Cyber Warfare rescue, and associated mission and flight operations, tactical space lift, deployment, mobilization, exercise, flying training systems both manned and unmanned, rescue, foreign military sales, PPBE, Program Element Monitoring (PEM), acquisition, special operations, or similar operations.

Desirable Experience:
Cyber, Communications and/or Information Technology, SATCOM, Cybersecurity, Spectrum Management, Policy Analyst, Strategy Analyst

You will be evaluated for this job based on how well you meet the qualifications above.

Your application package (resume, supporting documents) will be used to determine your eligibility, and qualifications.

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer
jobs.description:
Chief Technology Officer (CTO)
Department:Executive Leadership / Technology
Reports To: CEO / Board of Directors
Employment Type Full-Time
Location: United States -Remote

Job Summary

The Chief Technology Officer (CTO) is responsible for leading the company’s overall technology strategy, infrastructure, product development, cybersecurity, and technical operations. The CTO will align technology initiatives with business objectives, drive innovation, build high-performing engineering teams, and ensure the company maintains scalable, secure, and reliable technology systems.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop and execute the company’s long-term technology strategy and roadmap.
* Lead technology, engineering, software development, IT, data, and cybersecurity functions.
* Translate business goals into effective technology solutions and initiatives.
* Oversee the design, development, deployment, and maintenance of software products and platforms.
* Establish scalable technology architecture and infrastructure.
* Ensure systems are secure, reliable, high-performing, and cost-effective.
* Lead digital transformation and adoption of emerging technologies, including AI and automation.
* Establish technology standards, development processes, and best practices.
* Manage technology budgets, vendors, technology investments, and resource allocation.
* Recruit, develop, mentor, and retain senior technical talent.
* Work closely with the CEO, COO, CFO, CPO, and other executives on strategic initiatives.
* Identify and manage technology risks, cybersecurity threats, and compliance requirements.
* Establish KPIs and performance metrics for technology teams and initiatives.
* Evaluate new technologies, platforms, tools, and strategic partnerships.
* Ensure business continuity, disaster recovery, data protection, and system availability.
* Communicate complex technical concepts and technology strategy to executive leadership and stakeholders.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Master’s degree or MBA is preferred.
* **10+ years of experience** in technology, software engineering, IT, or a related field.
* **5+ years of leadership/management experience**, preferably at a senior or executive level.
* Proven experience developing and executing technology strategies.
* Experience leading engineering or technology organizations.
* Strong understanding of cloud computing, software architecture, cybersecurity, databases, APIs, and modern development practices.
* Experience managing technology budgets and large-scale projects.
* Strong knowledge of Agile, DevOps, CI/CD, and software development lifecycle practices.

Preferred Skills

* Strategic leadership and business acumen
* Software and systems architecture
* Cloud platforms and infrastructure
* Artificial intelligence and machine learning
* Cybersecurity and risk management
* Data analytics and technology governance
* Product development
* Digital transformation
* Vendor and partner management
* Budget and resource management
* Executive communication and presentation
* Change management

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Technology uptime and system reliability
* Product development and delivery timelines
* Technology cost efficiency
* Cybersecurity and compliance performance
* Engineering productivity
* Product quality and customer experience
* Successful implementation of technology roadmap
* Employee retention and development within technology teams
* Innovation and adoption of strategic technologies

jobs.title: Chief Information Officer
jobs.description:
Company Description
Venture Capital is dedicated to exploring the future of investing through fresh, innovative insights that challenge conventional thinking. The organization focuses on unique, actionable strategies and game-changing market perspectives that push the boundaries of what is possible in venture capital. Content is designed to inspire creative, out-of-the-box approaches while questioning the status quo. Information shared is for educational purposes only, with a strong emphasis on independent research and informed decision-making due to the inherent risks of venture capital investing.
Role Description
The Chief Information Officer (CIO) is a full-time, remote role responsible for leading the overall information technology vision and strategy for Venture Capital. This role oversees IT operations, infrastructure, and security to ensure reliable, compliant, and scalable systems that support digital content and data-driven decision-making. The CIO collaborates with executive leadership to align IT strategy with business goals, optimize business processes, and identify technology opportunities that enhance innovation and user experience. Day-to-day responsibilities include managing IT teams and vendors, setting and monitoring technology KPIs, overseeing system design and implementation, and establishing policies for data governance, cybersecurity, and business continuity. The CIO is also expected to stay current with emerging technologies relevant to venture capital and recommend solutions that improve efficiency, analytics, and collaboration.
Qualifications

Strong background in Information Technology, including architecture, infrastructure, and security, with the ability to oversee complex digital environments.
Proven experience in IT Operations, such as system administration, network management, service delivery, and incident/change management.
Demonstrated IT Management capabilities, including team leadership, vendor management, budget oversight, and performance measurement.
Expertise in IT Strategy and Business Process design to align technology initiatives with organizational objectives and improve operational efficiency.
Experience implementing cloud-based solutions, data analytics platforms, and collaboration tools in a digital or financial-services context.
Knowledge of cybersecurity best practices, regulatory considerations, and data privacy standards relevant to investment or financial information.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts into clear business recommendations.
Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field; an advanced degree or relevant certifications (e.g., CIO, ITIL, CISSP, PMP) are beneficial.
Experience working in or with investment, financial services, or technology-driven content organizations is an advantage.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Cybersecurity, AI SOC & Crisis Management - Remote
jobs.description:
Preference will be given to candidates residing in the Eastern or Central time zones.

As a Senior Manager, AI Security Operations & Crisis Management, you will lead the enterprise Cyber Incident Response Team (CIRT) and coordinate incidents through recovery and closure. You will advance AI-enabled operations and crisis readiness with Investigations, Threat Hunting & Forensics and enterprise partners.

What you will do:

Technical Responsibilities:

Lead global CIRT operations, including follow-the-sun coverage, escalation, containment, recovery, closure, and continuity during outages.
Oversee managed detection and response providers, including readiness, governance, performance, escalation quality, budgets, licensing, and commitments.
Advance responsible AI-assisted triage, investigation, decision support, documentation, and response with oversight, approvals, auditability, and reversibility.
Own the Cyber Defense digital twin roadmap and operationalize capabilities by defining use cases, requirements, success measures, acceptance, adoption, and legacy retirement.
Direct incident response; govern non-destructive containment and automated actions; and engage Investigations, Threat Hunting & Forensics when required.
Monitor response time, escalation and case quality, automation effectiveness, queue health, service levels, and corrective actions.
Own the detection content lifecycle with Detection Engineering, including rule development, tuning, coverage mapping, and deprecation.
Partner with Cyber Threat Intelligence, Threat Exposure Management, Vulnerability Management, Security Engineering, and Enterprise Technology to improve response.

Leadership & People Management Responsibilities:

Own cyber crisis management and CIRT activation, including severity criteria, escalation thresholds, leadership notifications, governance, and operational coordination.
Lead executive briefings, stakeholder updates, reporting, communication cadence, and documentation of significant decisions.
Coordinate response with crisis, communications, legal, privacy, human resources, procurement, continuity, and technology operations teams.
Lead executive tabletop, functional, and technical exercises; maintain the roadmap and close corrective actions.
Lead post-incident reviews and incorporate technical findings and root-cause lessons into playbooks and readiness activities.
Build CIRT leadership depth through coaching, exercises, structured development, and clear performance expectations.

Knowledge and Capabilities:

Apply incident response, recovery, crisis communications, business continuity, and crisis coordination practices during high-pressure events.
Translate issues into business terms and coordinate concurrent workstreams using risk-based decisions.
Integrate FDA, HIPAA, SEC cyber disclosure, sanctions compliance, and other reporting considerations into response processes.
Address threats involving contractors and contingent workers through identity verification and access revocation coordination.
Participate in after-hours or on-call incident response and crisis management activities as required.

What You Need:

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, or a related field.
Minimum 10 years of experience in cybersecurity operations, incident response, crisis management, technology operations, or enterprise service delivery.
Minimum 5 years of leadership experience managing technical teams, global operations, strategic initiatives, or managed services.
Experience leading significant cybersecurity incidents with technical, business, legal, communications, and executive stakeholders.
Experience managing a Security Operations Center, CIRT, Managed Detection and Response service, or comparable operational capability.
Experience implementing or governing AI-enabled workflows, automation, orchestration, or technology-enabled operational transformation.

Preferred Qualifications

Master's degree in Cybersecurity, Business Administration, Technology Management, or a related discipline.
Professional certification such as CISSP, CISM, GCIH, ITIL, PMP, or equivalent.

Posted Date: 09/14/2026 This role will be posted for a minimum of 3 days.
